However, the official author list is Minying Zhao, Fan Feng, Chunfang Chu, Wentao Yue, and Lin Li, while the citation lists Zhao S, Li G, Dalgleish R, Vujovic S, Jiao X, and Li J. This is a real paper, but the cited author list appears to be incorrect.
